arms.name: AnyCode native single agent with common sandbox and budget controls
arms.notes: AnyCode 0.9.0 native loop and scheduler with the neutral six-tool OpenSandbox adapter; no context plane, no router, no ownership policy, no action gate. Guarded one-million-token cell budget and per-request metering are added by the evaluation adapter only.

arms.name: AtlasRuntime direct-only main-driven runtime
arms.notes: the full goal runtime with `DelegationConfig(enabled=False)`: neither `delegate_tasks` nor `delegate.read` exists in the tool surface.

arms.name: AtlasRuntime static DAG
arms.notes: a human-authored decomposition frozen into the plan and executed by the AnyCode scheduler; one shared budget and one shared workspace; no Main exists.

arms.name: AtlasRuntime dynamic selective delegation
arms.notes: the same goal runtime with delegation enabled, router m.1.0, both worker profiles disclosed through the capability card.

static_dag.objective: parsing and normalisation modules
static_dag.assignment:
[YOUR ASSIGNMENT — worker parse]

static_dag.objective: Repair the bounded broker and the retry policy
static_dag.assignment:
[YOUR ASSIGNMENT — worker queue]
You own `eventsys/broker.py` and `eventsys/retry.py`.

OBJECTIVE: a full broker must raise `QueueFull` and never drop; duplicate ids must be `DuplicateEvent`; `take` must move the envelope into the in-flight set and journal the take; `ack` must be idempotent; `nack` must return to the front with one more attempt; `dead_letter` must record once; and the retry policy must validate its values and cap the delay at `max_delay`, counting the first attempt. The rules are in `docs/INTERFACE.md`.

OWNED FILES: the two modules above. `store.py`, `journal.py`, `consumer.py`, `recovery.py` and `pipeline.py` belong to the other workers; read them, do not edit them.

DEFINITION OF DONE: `python -m pytest -q test_public.py` passes for the broker and retry checks, and you report what you ran.

The formats and error rules are in `docs/INTERFACE.md`.

OWNED FILES: the three modules above. The broker and consumer belong to the other workers; read them, do not edit them.

DEFINITION OF DONE: `python -m pytest -q test_public.py` passes for the persistence and journal checks, and you report what you ran.

pricing.basis: frozen config; the file itself labels it an upper bound for deepseek-chat
pricing.missing_cache_split: price the whole input as a miss; never assume a hit

settlement_contract.rule: min(frozen batch allowance, owner authorization, global remaining)
settlement_contract.refuses: a missing prior report, an unconsumed prior claim, a plan or executor identity mismatch, incomplete usage, a prior frozen stop, or no remaining headroom

incomplete_counterbalance: three repetitions cannot visit all four execution positions; each task sees three of the four quaternions
